findings.location: Increment H — The rubric, the prompt and the bridge call
findings.problem: The plan never specifies the required model-bridge invocation shape. A conforming bridge exposes `wb run ask-<vendor> ask [options]`, but the plan only says to call the selected bridge through `wb run`; it also does not explicitly separate validation of the bridge envelope from validation of the JSON verdict carried in its `reply`. This leaves the central integration under-specified and can produce a call that every conforming bridge refuses.
findings.suggestion: State and test the exact argv: `wb run <configured-bridge> ask --timeout 20 --schema <shipped-schema> [--model ...] [--effort ...]`, with the prompt on stdin. Require validation of the model-bridge result envelope before parsing and validating its `reply`, including failure objects and malformed success envelopes.

summary: The plan otherwise reflects the named roadmap candidate and specifications, but its bridge integration must be made executable and testable.
